info.title: Channel Webhooks
info.description: Recieve real time webhook events for various store operations

servers.description: Placeholder for the webhook URL channels will provide to Deliverect during setup.

channelLink.description: ID of the channel link requesting the SSO, to be redirected to.

redirectUrl.description: url to redirect after the authorization is completed

customer.description: SSO verified customer (firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, providerId)

menu.description: The name of the menu. Always present.

menuTranslations.description: Translation of the menu name with language codes as keys (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-translations)).

descriptionTranslations.description: Translation of the menu description with language codes as keys (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-translations)).

menuImageURL.description: Header/Banner image url of the menu (more info on images [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/images-menu)).

menuId.description: Internal Deliverect menu id. Always present.

menuType.description: Five different types of menus, with each representing the intended ordering type for which the menu is suitable: DELIVERY_AND_PICKUP = `0`, DELIVERY = `1`, PICKUP = `2`, EAT_IN = `3`, CURBSIDE = `4`. Always present.

channelLinkId.description: The id for the channelLink that this menu is published to. Always present.

nestedModifiers.description: Indicates if nested modifiers are present in the menu (see section [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-modifer-groups#nested-modifiers) for further reference). Always present.

productTags.description: Array of all tags that exist in the menu (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-product-metadata)).

availabilities.description: The times during which the menu should be available. This will in most cases equate to the store's opening hours.

products.description: Keyed object of products, sharing a common structure with `modifiers` and `modifierGroups` (collectively referred to as *items* in this schema's descriptions). Keyed by product `_id`.

modifiers.description: Keyed object of modifiers, sharing a common structure with `products` and `modifierGroups` (collectively referred to as *items* in this schema's descriptions). Keyed by modifier `_id`.

modifierGroups.description: Keyed object of modifier groups, sharing a common structure with `products` and `modifiers` (collectively referred to as *items* in this schema's descriptions). Keyed by modifier group `_id`.

snoozedProducts.description: PLUs of products and modifiers that are currently snoozed and should be unavailable on the menu, keyed by a unique snooze reference.

validations.description: Legacy attribute. Not to be referenced as part of an integration.

bundles.description: Legacy attribute. Bundle configuration for the menu. Not documented in the menu parameters glossary; observed as an object in the menu update payload example. Shape unconfirmed — treat as an opaque object until documented.

Exemple de produit de base avec - groupes de modificateurs - variables min/max - su00e9lection par du00e9faut - traductions

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: The state parameter protects against XSRF attacks

locationId.description: ID of a location in the customer account.

channelLinkId.description: Unique ID of the store on the channel platform.

operations.description: Snooze or unsnooze operations to apply.

action.description: Action to apply to the listed items.

plu.description: Product lookup code (PLU) for the item.

snoozeStart.description: UTC timestamp at which the snooze period starts.

snoozeEnd.description: UTC timestamp at which the snooze period ends.

allSnoozedItems.description: Complete list of items that should currently be snoozed.

plu.description: Product lookup code (PLU) for the item.

snoozeStart.description: UTC timestamp at which the snooze period starts.

snoozeEnd.description: UTC timestamp at which the snooze period ends.

Availability.description: A recurring weekly time window during which the parent entity should be available.

dayOfWeek.description: An integer value that indicates the day of the week for this availability (starting at `1` for Monday).

startTime.description: A 24-hour `HH:MM` format notation of the start time of availability expressed in the local time of the location.

endTime.description: A 24-hour `HH:MM` format notation of the end time of availability expressed in the local time of the location.

category.description: Unique ID of the menu category.

_id.description: Internal Deliverect id of the category.

nameTranslations.description: Translations of the category name with language codes as keys (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-translations)).

descriptionTranslations.description: Translation of the category description with language codes as keys (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-translations)).

imageUrl.description: Image url of the category (see more info on images [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/images-menu)).

subProducts.description: Products that exist under each category, see [guide here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-sort-categories-items) for more context on correct sorting.

menu.description: The unique ID of the menu this category belongs to.

account.description: The unique ID of the account this category belongs to.

subCategories.description: List of child category IDs, present in retail catalogs.

posLocationId.description: Legacy attribute. Not to be referenced as part of an integration.

products.description: Legacy attribute. For correct sorting of products in categories, see `subProducts`.

posCategoryType.description: Legacy attribute. Not to be referenced as part of an integration.

posCategoryId.description: Legacy attribute. Not to be referenced as part of an integration.

sortedChannelProductIds.description: Legacy attribute. For correct sorting of products in categories, see `subProducts`.

subProductSortOrder.description: Legacy attribute. For correct sorting of products in categories, see `subProducts`.

level.description: Legacy attribute. Not to be referenced as part of an integration.

MenuItem.description: Shared structure for `products`, `modifiers`, and `modifierGroups` (collectively referred to as *items*). Only a small number of attributes apply to certain product types only, clarified where applicable.

_id.description: Identifier of a particular item and its location in the menu structure.

plu.description: Unique identifier of the item, to be used when creating orders.

gtin.description: GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) for product, which could be an EAN code. NB: these are not validated as yet.

imageUrl.description: Image associated with the item (see more info on images [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-images)).

price.description: Price of the item with 2 decimal digits, e.g. 1 euro is stored as 100.

nameTranslations.description: Translation of an item name with language codes as keys (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-translations)).

descriptionTranslations.description: Translation of the item description with language codes as keys (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-translations)).

deliveryTax.description: Sales tax specific on order type of 'Delivery' for the item. Tax rates are always stored as an int with 3 decimal digits, e.g. 5% would be sent as `5000`.

takeawayTax.description: Sales tax specific on order type of 'Takeaway' for the item. Tax rates are always sent as an int with 3 decimal digits, e.g. 5% would be sent as `5000`.

eatInTax.description: Sales tax specific on order type of 'Eat-in' for the item. Tax rates are always sent as an int with 3 decimal digits, e.g. 5% would be sent as `5000`.

max.description: Maximum number of items under a group to be purchased.

min.description: Minimum number of items under a group to be purchased.

multiMax.description: Maximum quantity of any single item which can be purchased within a group (modifier group). Also applicable to products, where it should control how many items can be added to a basket, e.g. Paracetamol.

defaultQuantity.description: Controls the behaviour of 'pre-selected' items, where a quantity >0 should be automatically selected (typically '1'); higher default quantities can also be set.

multiply.description: Used in a modifier group to show this product multiple times in the GUI; `1` means one entry (so no copies).

isCombo.description: Indicates if a product is a combo item/meal deal.

isVariant.description: Applicable to a **product** to indicate if it is a variant or not (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-variants)).

isVariantGroup.description: Applicable to a **modifier group** to indicate if it is a variant or not (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-variants)).

snoozed.description: Indicates whether an item is snoozed at the point of a menu being published.

visible.description: Legacy attribute. The value will always be set to `true` as disabled items won't appear in the menu payload.

productTags.description: All tags which apply to this item, see complete list [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-product-metadata).

account.description: Unique customer account ID where the item is stored.

referenceId.description: The original PLU of the item, only for tracking sales, e.g. for loyalty purposes. Not to be included in the payload for order creation.

location.description: Unique customer location ID where the item is stored.

capacityUsages.description: Legacy attribute. Not to be referenced as part of an integration.

isUpsell.description: Indicates if the **modifier group** is an Upsell group.

subProducts.description: List of items belonging to the group.

caloriesRangeHigh.description: If a range is supported, the minimum is `calories` and maximum is `caloriesRangeHigh`.

nutritionalInfo.description: Expressed in grams, e.g. `fat`, `sugar`, `saturatedFat`, `carbohydrates`, `protein`, `salt`, etc (see this section of the product guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-product-metadata)).

unitType.description: What the serving size unit type is; Weight (in grams) = `1`, Volume (in milliliter) = `2`, Count (i.e., piece, slice, capsule, cookie, etc) = `3`.
What the net quantity unit type is; Weight (in grams) = `1`, Volume (in milliliter) = `2`, Count (i.e., piece, slice, capsule, cookie, etc) = `3`.

reusable.description: Whether packaging is re-usable or not.

supplementalInfo.description: Additional information about an item, for more information see [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-handle-product-metadata).

prepackaged.description: Specifies whether the item is prepackaged.

deposit.description: In certain regions a deposit is required for e.g. bottled drinks; this will be included in the price, yet the deposit should be clearly displayed to the consumer. Deposit expressed to 2 decimal digits, e.g. 1 euro is stored as 100 (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v3.0-ordering-experience/docs/how-to-set-bottle-deposits)).

fbo.description: Details of the food business operator.

countryOfOrigin.description: Food business operator country of origin.

parentId.description: Legacy attribute. Follow each `subProducts` array recursively from the top level down to determine nesting. `parentId` is legacy and shouldn't be used.

posCategoryIds.description: The POS ID of the category this product belongs to in the POS.

posProductCategoryId.description: The ID of this product in the POS, internal to POS, not to be used when creating orders.

posProductId.description: The ID of this product in the POS, internal to POS, not to be used when creating orders.

subProductSortOrder.description: A list of product PLUs belonging to this product that preserves the order of these sub-products.

metadata.description: A list of custom key/value pairings added to product data, e.g. `"metadata": [{"key": "highlight", "value": "true"}]`.

displayLabels.description: List of labels for marketing purposes applied to products, e.g. `{"displayLabels": ["new", "popular"]}`.

SnoozedProduct.description: A single snoozed item entry, keyed by a unique snooze reference (format `"65********************1d"`) under `snoozedProducts`.

location.description: Deliverect location ID where the item is snoozed.

snoozeStart.description: Timestamp in UTC when snooze begins, format `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

snoozeEnd.description: Timestamp in UTC when snooze ends, format `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.
